{{Quote|Spacers think that ships and fuel just pop into the galaxy through a black hole or something. Slip the blockades, tease the Imperials, run the Kessel and Byss and Twin Stars; it's all fun and glamor for those starry-eyed flyboys.|[[Chaster Fel Gaargaaz]]|<ref name="SWG:GSSNaLT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Got Some Spacers Need a Lesson Taught}} on Corellia</ref>}}
The '''Byss Run''' was a hyperlane located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It was so perilous and changing that it was only kept open and stable with hundreds of non-mass [[S-thread booster/Legends|S-thread boosters]] planted within [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] at a high cost.

==Astrography==
The Byss Run was the primary hyperroute to and from the Deep Core [[Beshqek system]], which contained the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], the location of the Reborn [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] Empire. It started at the planet [[Empress Teta]] in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]], and passed by the [[Keeara Major system/Legends|Keeara Major system]], the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]], and the [[Odik system/Legends|Odik system]], before reaching the [[Beshqek system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Byss Run was artificially built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at some point after [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="Endor and the Moddell Sector">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> and held together by hundreds of S-thread boosters, operating at a high cost.<ref name="TEA" />

[[Salla Zend]] proved herself to be one of the best when she succeeded in smuggling [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] on to Byss in an attempt to rescue [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> When Byss was [[Destruction of Byss|destroyed]] after the [[Galaxy Gun]] accidentally fired on it, millions of refugees from [[Relus]], another planet in the Beshqek system, fled to the other planets along the Byss Run. Afterwards, the energies of the deep core erased the Byss Run, causing the Beshqek system to become unreachable and stranding the other planets.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
In Part 4 of [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]'s endnotes for ''The Essential Atlas'', Jason Fry mentioned that the Byss Run and the secret route [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] took to abducting [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] correspond.<ref name="endnotes">{{Blog|danwallace|146|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 4 of 5)}}</ref>
